question: Does CityUpdate 0x82D13978 contain one authoritative per-city Culture credit, and what do the adjacent owner accumulator transaction and the city +0x48 consumers establish about where a flat Culture addition could land?

scope.boundary: The selected stores and consumers are mapped. A per-city Culture bank, the complete set of Culture consumers and the intended destination of a flat Culture addition are not established.

dependencies.use: Provides the retained r18 value, the accumulator store and the mode checks.
Classifies the UEA 23 half term as Great Person generation.
Provides the border sweep reads of city +0x48.
Provides the Temple contribution that reaches city +0x48.

accumulatorTransaction.baseline: On the continuing path, 0x82D15608 loads 0x830ED484 + owner*4, 0x82D1560C forms r7 = old word + retained r18, and 0x82D15614 stores r7. The word is owner indexed, not city indexed.
accumulatorTransaction.uea23Term: 0x82D15618 queries cumulative UEA 23. A nonzero return reloads the word at 0x82D15628 and stores old-after-baseline + signed truncation toward zero of r18/2 at 0x82D15634. A zero return joins at 0x82D15638.
accumulatorTransaction.multiplicity: One baseline store and zero or one extra store per traversal of this straight-line block. The two stores are one native accumulator transaction, not two independent Culture credits.
accumulatorTransaction.classification: The accepted UEA ownership result classifies the half term as Great Person generation. The word is not a per-city Culture bank.
accumulatorTransaction.qualification: Complete reachability of the block for every mode and the complete set of readers of this accumulator are not established.

cityInputs.cityStore: 0x82D152E8..0x82D152F0 stores the low halfword of retained r18 to city +0x48 on selected recomputing paths. Mode zero also adds r18 to owner row 0x830EE388 + owner*0x28 + 0x10 at 0x82D15310.
cityInputs.borderSweep: The border owner 0x82CBE528 reads signed city +0x48 at 0x82CBE854 and 0x82CBE860 and at 0x82CBE8D0 and 0x82CBE8DC. Derived terms are added to indexed halfwords through retained r14 + 0x208 and stored at 0x82CBE88C and 0x82CBE914..0x82CBE92C.
cityInputs.calendarCache: On one continuing cached path, 0x82D1FAB8..0x82D1FAD8 adds signed city +0x48 to 0x830EE388 + incomingPlayer*0x28 + 0x10 and 0x82D1FADC branches to 0x82D1FC18, past the first mode-zero call. The block holds no reserve or UEA 23 accumulator store.
cityInputs.laterClearing: UEA 42 clearing at 0x82D15350..0x82D1536C leaves city +0x48 and r18 intact. The owner byte comparison with 0x82F700B0 can clear stack +0x7C, r18 and r20 at 0x82D153C0..0x82D153EC without rewriting the earlier city +0x48 store.
cityInputs.qualification: These are real accumulations of the city value. They are not shown to be interchangeable with the 0x82D15614 accumulator or with a Culture bank.

scalingDistinction.native: With the UEA 23 term active, a native r18 equal to C stores old + C + trunc(C/2) into the accumulator (low 32 bits), where old is the word before the block. With old 100 and C 6 the stored value is 109.
scalingDistinction.changeR18: Changing r18 from C to C + N before 0x82D15614 changes the transaction by N + trunc((C + N)/2) - trunc(C/2). This is generally neither N nor N + trunc(N/2).
scalingDistinction.changeStoreOperand: Changing only r7, the operand of the store at 0x82D15614, leaves native r18 for the later half term and gives a flat delta of N in the accumulator.
scalingDistinction.qualification: Native low 32 bit arithmetic applies. Whether a flat Culture addition should reach this Great Person accumulator, its UEA 23 modifier, the city +0x48 value or another consumer is not decided by the static evidence.

candidateDestinations.role: cache value before the mode -1 exit
candidateDestinations.note: Assign the freshly computed native value plus N to city +0x48, not the old composed value plus N. Mode zero also needs the matching N in owner row +0x10 once. Display and border consumers of +0x48 are not closed.
Adds exactly N to the owner accumulator with native r18 unchanged. Does not update city +0x48 or owner row +0x10.

candidateDestinations.role: accumulator join after the UEA 23 term
candidateDestinations.note: One flat N per traversal after the baseline and optional half term. It is an extra word mutation and is not needed when the store operand can be edited.
Adds to the incoming player row. A cached city +0x48 already includes a composed cache bonus, so adding N again doubles it. Not a sole credit point.

currentEvidence.method: Three foreground read-only raw word queries over the listed ranges, checked against the pinned flat image. All 594 queried words matched. No generated code was read and no runtime action was performed.

entries.role: city +0x48 store and owner row addition

currentEvidence.qualification: The destination interpretations are candidates composed from these local stores.

runtimeObservation.qualification: No city update, accumulator store or Culture result was observed at runtime.

guards: Do not name 0x830ED484 a city Culture bank.
Do not suppress UEA 23 to make an assumed Culture delta equal N.
Do not add N to r18 and expect a flat accumulator delta.
Do not add N to a cached city +0x48 contribution that already includes a composed bonus.
Do not infer Culture consumer coverage, display parity, once per city turn cadence or runtime acceptance.
conclusion: No single authoritative per-city Culture credit is established. The adjacent owner accumulator at 0x830ED484 is a Great Person generation word that receives r18 at 0x82D15614 and optionally half of it at 0x82D15634. City +0x48 is a retained cache that feeds the border sweep and an owner row. A flat addition has four candidate landing points with different scaling and double counting behavior, and the intended Culture destination remains an open decision.
